remaining.title: Fix release identity in production
remaining.detail: The mechanism now exists: scripts/deploy-prod.mjs reads the SHA and ref from git and passes them as QUEUEPROOF_RELEASE_SHA and QUEUEPROOF_RELEASE_REF, which is exactly the fallback /api/health/live consumes. It has never been executed.
remaining.blocker: The permission classifier refused `pnpm deploy:prod` because it runs `vercel deploy --prod --yes` against live production and the session's only direction, 'continue finish all tasks make this fuly compete', never names production as the target. Clearing it requires the user to explicitly authorise deploying to production at queueproof.vercel.app, or to run the command outside auto mode so the prompt is reviewed directly.

remaining.title: Fix grounded synthesis defect D1
remaining.detail: Root cause found: tokenise() stems 'atlas' to 'atla', so an Atlas Copco recruiter advert scored identically to the genuine Linear receipt. c67352b adds an impediment gate in relevance() plus a token-subset restatement check in duplicatesPicked, with three regression tests over an atlasBlockerCorpus fixture. Verified by unit test, not yet by live probe, because the fix is not deployed.
remaining.companionSymptom: CONFIRMED CORRECT, NOT A DEFECT. 'What did we ship most recently and what proves it?' abstains with 0 citations live, and that is the designed behaviour. lib/server/synthesis.ts:199-203 scores an unanchored delivery question at 0 unless the candidate both comes from a DELIVERY_RECORD_PROVIDER and matches DELIVERY_ASSERTION, so bare prose containing the word 'ship' cannot support an answer. Paired tests prove both directions: tests/synthesis.test.ts:749 'abstains instead of stitching newsletters that only mention the word ship' asserts abstained at :804, and :815 runs the same question against a real delivery record and asserts not abstained at :834. This is the intent committed in 27b6ab7 and 9469b5b. Do not 'fix' it.

remaining.title: Add dist/** to eslint globalIgnores
remaining.detail: One-line change: append "dist/**" to globalIgnores([...]) in eslint.config.mjs, currently [".next/**", "out/**", "build/**", "next-env.d.ts"].
remaining.blocker: The ECC config-protection PreToolUse hook blocks edits to eslint.config.mjs: 'BLOCKED: Modifying eslint.config.mjs is not allowed... If this is a legitimate config change, disable the config-protection hook temporarily.' Gating is process-env (ECC_HOOK_PROFILE, default standard; ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS) and cannot be changed mid-session. Unblock with ECC_HOOK_PROFILE=minimal or ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS=pre:config-protection.
remaining.impact: Cosmetic. `pnpm lint` passes because the script carries --ignore-pattern dist; only a bare `eslint .` fails, with 41 errors, all in generated dist/ bundles and 0 in source.

remaining.title: Resolve the uncommitted CSS edits
remaining.detail: The removed product.css block was a dead light-theme leftover. Live token probe proved --paper resolves to #faf7f2, so `select { color: var(--paper); background-color: #fff }` painted near-white text on white at 1.07:1. After the change the select renders rgb(238,234,240) on rgb(13,13,17) at 16.31:1 and the toolbar label at 6.55:1. Measured against the live loaded stylesheets by injecting the .queue-toolbar markup into the running page; stated openly as an injection, not the mounted component.

remaining.title: Run the full release gate
remaining.detail: All six commands run with real output pasted. See verifiedTests.

remaining.title: Push, deploy and verify the release
remaining.detail: Push done: 993bd9e..358aac8 codex/dialog-autofocus -> codex/dialog-autofocus. Deploy blocked by P1. After deploying, run `pnpm release:verify -- --url https://queueproof.vercel.app --sha 358aac8`.

remaining.title: Re-measure benchmarks on the deployed SHA
remaining.detail: pnpm benchmark:live, pnpm benchmark:pdf, pnpm benchmark:publish. Confirm /api/lab reports the same SHA and /benchmarks shows measured rows. Run both explicit modes if a Fast-vs-Thinking claim is wanted; modeComparison.comparable must become true.
remaining.warning: Do NOT regenerate BENCHMARK_REPORT.md with `pnpm benchmark:router`. A fixture-only run silently deletes the 'SHA-bound live connector runs' section and rewrites the fixture line. This happened twice and was reverted with `git checkout -- BENCHMARK_REPORT.md evals/results/` both times. Only the full live run may rewrite that artifact.

remaining.title: Record an authenticated MCP client smoke test
remaining.detail: Unauthenticated surface verified against production: POST /mcp tools/list returns {"error":"invalid_token"}, HTTP 401, Www-Authenticate: Bearer, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. Reading app/mcp/route.ts confirmed the auth model is DB-backed bearer tokens against mcp_tokens (sha256 hash, audience, revoked_at IS NULL, expiry) with a constant-time configured-token fallback, NOT OAuth, so the absent /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource (404) is a design choice, not a defect. Protocol surface is covered by tests/mcp.test.ts inside the green suite.
remaining.blocker: An authenticated call needs a real token. No token was minted or stored, per the standing instruction not to store secrets or connector credentials.

remaining.title: Decide the branch strategy
remaining.detail: No divergence exists. `git merge-base --is-ancestor 993bd9e 358aac8` succeeds and `git rev-list --count 993bd9e..358aac8` is 5, so remote main fast-forwards cleanly. Hold the fast-forward until the deploy verifies, so main points at what is actually running. Local main also needs updating from the stale a884e8d.

remaining.title: Refresh submission copy with current-release numbers
remaining.detail: docs/SUBMISSION_COPY.md, docs/HACKATHON_FORM.md and submission/* still pin metrics to release aed0278. Those files already carry explicit banners saying the numbers bind to that runtime and do not transfer, so they are honest today; they become wrong only if numbers are moved to a new SHA without re-measuring. submission/verified-facts-not-yet-in-marketing.md gained item 12 this session, forbidding any claim about the two undeployed fixes.

remaining.title: Produce the final 60-second video script
remaining.detail: docs/DEMO_SCRIPT_60S.md is the canonical script and is deliberately metric-free: it instructs the recorder to read the on-screen values bound to the running release and to say 'this release is awaiting a comparable mode pair' when modeComparison.comparable is false. submission/60-second-script.md is an intentional redirect to it. No rewrite was needed; recording is a user action and is gated on the deploy.

confirmedDefects.title: Grounded synthesis glues unrelated evidence onto the answer
confirmedDefects.reproduce: curl -sS -X POST https://queueproof.vercel.app/api/ask -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"question":"What is blocking the Atlas launch?","mode":"auto"}'
confirmedDefects.observed: HTTP 200, 6.15s, 4 citations. The answer leads and ends with an Atlas Copco job-listing fragment, claims [2] and [3] are near-duplicates, and the question is never answered.
confirmedDefects.cause: tokenise() stems 'atlas' to 'atla', so an Atlas Copco recruiter advert and the genuine Linear receipt scored identically.
confirmedDefects.note: Fixed in source and covered by three regression tests. Still reproduces live because the fix is not deployed. Re-probe after deploying.

confirmedDefects.title: Release identity is null in production
confirmedDefects.observed: /api/health/live release.commitSha null, commitRef null, target production, deployment queueproof-n1zo1ybn5. /api/lab currentRelease.commitSha null, caseCount 39; live and pdf both awaiting_current_release_measurement; modeComparison not_measured.
confirmedDefects.cause: Deployment configuration: CLI deploys inject no VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA because there is no Vercel Git integration. Route logic is unit-proven by tests/health-release.test.ts.

lastProgress: Session 3. Three product commits landed and were pushed: c67352b (synthesis entity-token gate + 3 regression tests), aa30fc8 (readable selects, measured 1.07:1 -> 16.31:1), 358aac8 (deploy-prod script, deploy:prod script entry, .mcp.json gitignored). Full release gate run green: typecheck clean, lint clean, 46/46 files and 447/447 tests in 15.49s, 353/353 fixture assertions with router accuracy 42/42, build complete, deploy:check PASS. Production deploy was refused by the permission classifier and was not routed around, so production still runs the pre-session artifact and D1 still reproduces live. P3 blocked by the ECC config-protection hook. P10 resolved as a clean fast-forward. P12 confirmed already complete. Added item 12 to submission/verified-facts-not-yet-in-marketing.md forbidding claims about the undeployed fixes.
nextAction: Get explicit user authorisation for the production deploy, then run `pnpm deploy:prod` and `pnpm release:verify -- --url https://queueproof.vercel.app --sha <deployed sha>`. Everything else that remains is downstream of that one action.
